title: discover
description:
List the devices this transport can already use.

Distinct from `discoverCommissionable`, which finds devices that are not yet paired to anything. `discover` is a full snapshot and is safe to call at any time — the core uses it to re-sync after a `seq` gap (spec §10.2).

refresh.description: Ask the transport to re-interview devices rather than answer from cache. Slower, and may wake battery-powered devices.
